paragraphs.text: Gydolien Mor , sometimes referred to as Gydolien M'r was a young woman from the Kingdom of Khone on Dominaria .

Gydolien was one of the Numbered Ones , and, after a magical exercise with the other Numbered Ones and a Yalomar Cat , she was determined to be the most powerful wizard in Khone. She was trained to become powerful enough to summon a Scarzam Dragon for Sol'Kanar the Swamp King on the Date of Tribute .

After fifteen years, she allied with Chondaeh from the Kingdom of Shikar , and the dragon was summoned. Upon its back sat Sivitri Scarzam herself, and the planeswalker was able to sense that Sol'Kanar was the source of the poppies that had destroyed the rest of her dragons long ago. Sivitri immediately started attacking Sol'Kanar, but Gydolien was able to force both dragon and rider back through the portal they created. In a rage, Sol’Kanar destroyed the Kingdom of Khone, apparently under the impression it was Gydolien who had set him up, leaving Gydolien the only living Khonian. She then focused her attention on avenging her home.
Since the Armada comics were very intertwined, it is possible Gydolien was an ancestor of Grenfell Mor , and thus also of his daughter Gwendolyn Mor and his grandson Jared Carthalion .
